entities.name: Fire Hydrant
entities.rationale: Drawn fire hydrant representing the IoT devices collecting acoustic data.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Ingests daily acoustic signal files securely from the IoT network.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Stores and persists the incoming acoustic signals.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Runs containerized batch processing for acoustic algorithms to find correlations.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: ML model endpoint that predicts and assigns leak probability scores.

entities.name: ANALYST
entities.rationale: Human analyst team that receives leak probability scores and schedules field investigation.

visual_connections.description: Daily acoustic files are pushed via API Gateway.
Securely pushes and persists files to S3.
Triggers daily batch processing on container microservices.
Feeds persistent correlation data to ML endpoint for classification.
